name: Dr. Janine Kreft
reason: Work is mainly therapy: her own course site (learn-on-kreftscouch.teachable.com) presents her as a licensed clinical psychologist specialising in trauma and healing, with self-paced courses drawn from her therapy practice; podcast and event listings describe nervous-system and trauma work. Psychotherapy is not spiritual teaching and most items would fail the health rule. No main website, published email or contact form was found either.
